capabilities: Register an AQL CodeMirror mode for fenced code blocks
Highlight strings, operators, metadata, node references, and node classes
Provide default styles that work out of the box
Allow color overrides via a CSS snippet
extras: The README links to the ANNIS project and its documentation as background; the plugin only highlights AQL text and does not connect to an ANNIS server. Includes installation, update, and CSS customization instructions.
problem: Obsidian's built-in code block highlighting does not recognize AQL, so AQL queries in notes appear as plain uncolored text.
summary: Syntax highlighting plugin that renders ANNIS Query Language (AQL) tokens inside fenced code blocks tagged as aql.
